title: Add sccache support to config and setup; wire athena.toml later
summary: First of two landings for warm builds: add an optional sccache pin to the config schema, install it in setup with `cargo install --locked` (no hand-copied digests), and support an {athena_home} placeholder in env values. athena.toml is not touched, because the installed gate cannot parse a new field in the same commit; a follow-up job adopts the build and then sets RUSTC_WRAPPER.

defaults_applied.how: Use the maintained sccache crate instead of building a cache.
Config, placeholder, and path tests; cargo test and clippy must pass.
No claim that a digest was copied from upstream; decision record cites what was measured or labels estimates.
Only code and setup in this landing; athena.toml deferred.
A test enforces that the wrapper path derives from the single pinned version.
Installation logic stays in xtask Rust code, not shell.

assumptions: Per the user's reply, this job lands code and setup only; athena.toml is a later job after the new build is adopted.

sccache is installed with `cargo install --locked --version <v> --root <athena_home>/tools/sccache/<v>`, so no digests are needed; the user did not choose between this and tarballs, and the no-digest path avoids repeating the placeholder failure.
The new config field is optional (serde default), so the current athena.toml and the installed gate keep parsing.
Setup installs sccache only when the pin is present, so setup stays green with today's athena.toml.
The env placeholder expansion (currently {job_dir} and {side}) lives in crates/athena-core/src/invocation.rs and needs an {athena_home} addition.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs adds an optional `sccache` entry to Tools holding only a version (no sha256 table), defaulting to absent, so the existing athena.toml still parses.
athena.toml, defaults.toml, and other governance files are unchanged; no all-zero or placeholder digest is added anywhere.

xtask/src/main.rs setup installs the pinned sccache (when configured) before building Athena, skips it if already installed at tools/sccache/<version>, and fails with a clear message if the install fails.
Env value expansion supports an {athena_home} placeholder, and paths.rs derives the sccache binary path from the single pinned version.

docs/decisions.md has a new decision with alternatives (tarball with digests, cargo install, no cache) and tradeoffs, marks D46's sccache exclusion superseded, and states that athena.toml adoption follows in a later job; CHANGELOG.md has an entry that claims nothing unverified.
Run `cargo test --locked`: new tests pass, covering parsing with and without the sccache pin, {athena_home} expansion, and the sccache path derivation.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both pass.

out_of_scope: Editing athena.toml to set RUSTC_WRAPPER, SCCACHE_DIR, or the sccache pin (follow-up job after the build is adopted).
Changing CI workflows or toolchain configuration.
departures: Cost and time are a bit higher than the reference: the change spans config, xtask, placeholder expansion, tests, and a decision record, and cargo install is not run by checks.
